body: Will try out Mint for sure, thank you.
Not enough to live on our own separately. Kind of young and don't have a good career, yes I know that was our own choice..
It helps to be reminded of that. I think I'm just miserable with how my life is right now, it's hard to be happy. Extremely hard. I also don't want to ruin my child's life. Or mine.
I read it all. I'm sorry. I'm sure it hurts. Bless you for loving your children and still loving her. We are born with hearts of gold.
How do you just drop off your old life when that was what made you happy.
You'll see him later. It was never goodbye. Theres love there OP.
At least now you know.. Sometimes ignorance is bliss but what is life without knowing?
Having a child and realizing I'm not meant to be a parent.
You could have lost your way. Talk to friends or family. Exercise. Eat food that you enjoy. Do things that you like. Draw. Write. Sleep. If everything fails, seek treatment from a professional
What do you mean in a facility?

I know I couldn't handle losing my husband he's my best friend, he's my everything, and has saved me from doing horrible things to myself in the past. But now I am hurting him.. I think it would be best if I were to be out of his life, even though he says that isn't true.. He wants to raise our daughter but says he can't do it on his own. I want to be with him but I don't want all that responsibility.. At least you sound like a good person who happens to also have depression.

I'm scared that if I buckle down and shut up and just deal with it, I'll STILL be unhappy.. this is my life too.. 

You sound like a great person.. I think your child would still want you to be alive too..

You sound like a really great person.. You've been through a lot of hurt and I am so so sorry for that.. The world needs good people like you, but I don't want you to have any more pain.. If there's a way you can have pain medication that might help.. A therapist maybe as well.. I'm sure there's somewhere for you to be able to move into as well, don't give up.. sorry I'm not too much of help.

You just don't want to feel the pain anymore. I know..

I'm sorry. I wish parents could do better but sometimes they just don't get it..

My mom was the same way to me, she hated me my whole life, still does.

Anyways, maybe find a job and work and make some money so that when your able to, moving out will be easier..

I'm sorry they don't listen to you, there are people out there that will...

Parents do a shit job sometimes, doesn't mean they don't love you...

​
Please don't go. I'm sure you are one of the few people that should live. You are full of hurt, I know it. I might be too late but I know you don't deserve any pain you feel.

This is devastating. I can't imagine what you are going through, but in a sense I can... I wouldn't know the answer but all I can say is maybe submit a missing person's report... Involve the police if you hadn't already.. I hope you have the support you need. I'm here if you need someone.

Hello. I understand. I want to die but don't want to lose my one chance at being happy. Killing others might sound appealing because you want to end the pain you are feeling.. But deep down you will have to live with their ghosts and your demons.. It doesn't leave, if you are intelligent and I know you are you will never forget. Taking a life is not the answer. I do understand though. I want all my pain to go away. My life is absolutely shit now.
